newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down two cents on larger offering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down two cents on larger offering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down two cents at 15.00 ringgit ($6.01) a kg, pressured by a larger offering at the opening, traders said.
Gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday failed to lift the local price, they said.
"The larger offering weighed on the price but buying at the lower levels limited the fall," said one trader. Initial bids were for 91 tonnes against offers for 133 tonnes.
Final turnover was 101 tonnes, down from 109 on Friday.
The local price premium over LME narrowed to $10 a tonne from $55 previously.-Syed Azman(603-2308911) ($1=2.4970 ringgit)
